walkthroughs.body_html:
Geometry & Measures — a core area of GCSE Maths.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Geometry & Measures brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Geometry & Measures.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

sequence.def: Steepness m=(y2-y1)/(x2-x1) — the basic building block.
y=mx+c, built directly from a gradient and a point.
Gradients multiply to -1 — uses the gradient idea.
Length √((Δx)²+(Δy)²) via Pythagoras between two points.
Line touching circle at one point, perpendicular to the radius — combines all above.
